messages:
noah: Processor flagged account GLOB-77 for BIN probing and unauthorized refunds. Three chargebacks on 2026-05-03, dispute D-101900. Pls compile evidence and pause payouts.

riya: On it. Which txns?

noah: Txns 2301, 2302, 2303. All cross-border: billing country US, card issuing country MX. Chargebacks claim 'unauthorized transaction'.

finance-bot: Alert: cross-border velocity > threshold for GLOB-77. See /billing/alerts/GLOB-77/2026-05-03

harry: Quick triage: two refunds were issued via dashboard by user support_rep_5; one refund via API key sk-prod-abc123. Need audit trail for admin actions and API key last used IPs.

riya: Pulling admin audit and payout CSV now. Also checking KYC docs and merchant contact history.

ops-bot: Evidence checklist: invoice PDFs, merchant KYC date, admin audit trail (masked PAN last4), refund request timestamps, IP addresses, and webhook payloads. Use evidence_template_v3.pdf and include CLEAR timeline.

noah: Also check if merchant requested refunds from their end or if customer initiated chargebacks first. Processor often wants proof of authorization and refund policy notice.

riya: Ran log query: `./infra/audit --acct GLOB-77 --events refund,login,api_key_use --from 2026-05-02 --to 2026-05-04 | grep 2301`
Results show: support_rep_5 issued refunds at 2026-05-03T04:12:03Z and 04:35:10Z from IP 3.91.44.55; API key used at 05:01:22Z from IP 18.232.99.12.

harry: IPs look unrelated. Card PANs differ but same BIN range. Could be BIN-listing attack. Tag Risk and Fraud.

claire: From Risk: please also export device fingerprinting info and any 3DS auth outcomes. If we have PASS/FAIL for 3DS, include.

riya: 3DS results: txn 2302 had 3DS challenge passed; others no 3DS. Added to evidence pack.

noah: Approving temporary payouts hold for 72h. @harry confirm.

harry: Approving. Applying hold now.

riya: Evidence bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-disputes/GLOB-77/D-101900/evidence_bundle_v2.zip. Contents: invoices, admin_audit.txt (redacted), webhook_payloads.json (redacted), kyc_onboard.pdf, 3ds_report.csv. Sent to disputes@payments.vendor with subject 'D-101900 GLOB-77 evidence'.

finance-bot: Automated: evidence_submitted. Tracker: ticket://disputes/D-101900.

claire: Legal: if representment required, collect signed merchant TOS, proof of cardholder consent (IP, email receipt), and a clear chronology. Also prepare a short narrative for the processor.

noah: Will do. Closing thread once processor responds. Last update: evidence submitted at 1912345694.
